pages.text: Altered from $(5)Piercing$(), $(4)Battering$() increases the damage dealt based on the amount of armor the enemy has. Maximum level is $(4)IV$() and it conflicts with $(5)Piercing$(), $(5)Multishot$() and $(4)Star Release$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: When it comes to heavily armored targets, it can severely outperform other options damage-wise, but it's meaningless against unarmored ones.
